The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a workbench introduced with the [[Better Save Soul|Better Save Soul DLC]], that may be built in the [[Souls room]] after you unlock the [[Spiritualism (Tech Tree)|Updated equipment]] technology. The {{PAGENAME}} allows you to use a {{Item|Corpse}} to extract its {{Item|Harmed soul}} for farther healing.<br>
When the [[Harmed soul]] stays in a [[corpse]] for too long, it will eventually die and leave a [[Sin Shard]] behind. If this happens the [[corpse]] no longer can be used in a {{PAGENAME}}.

==Recipes==
To use the extractor, you place a body in it and click on the "Extractor soul" button in the crafting window. The craft is automatic and takes time. It can only be used once per [[corpse]]. With this process the extracted soul takes some damage based on the Soul extractor tier.
